topic: Mental Health Act consent to treatment documentation
usual_baseline: Forms usually exist but the paperwork around them is weak. Consent to treatment form 52% and capacity form 71% [3154]; T3 discussed with patient 11% [3158]; CTT list on the drug chart 24/31 [3140]. Community forms uploaded 99.8%, but letters referencing forms only 14% [3529].
fix_that_works: Whiteboard above the drug trolley flagging patients on T3, plus teaching using real incidents: off-T3 incidents fell from four to zero for four months; staff knowledge 58% to 71% [3533].
fix_that_fails: Re-audit with no reported intervention showed no change: capacity still 80% at admission and 60% at 3 months; SOAD request recorded 56% to 25%; T3 not documented for any patient [3158].
consultant_advice: Checking forms exist is not useful; they usually do. Audit whether every drug given is covered by the T2 or T3, with a visual prompt at the drug trolley. Capacity at three months is the item that stays poor.
